repos.name: app
repos.review_docs: `AGENTS.md`, `docs/code_review.md`, and every doc `AGENTS.md` names for the touched area
repos.fix_notes: create worktrees as `docs/worktrees.md` says; run `make test` and `make lint` on the changed files

rules.name: github-review-approved
rules.description: I approved a PR under review: stop pr-<n> and its Codex, remove the review slot worktree

rules.name: github-review-requested
rules.description: My review is requested: check the PR out in a free slot and start the reviewer

rules.name: github-my-pr-comments
rules.description: Others commented on my PR: start pr-replies-<n> in the branch worktree, or ping it

rules.name: github-my-pr-merged
rules.description: My PR merged: stop pr-replies-<n>, remove its clean branch worktree and branch

rules.name: github-my-pr-conflicts
rules.description: My open PR conflicts with its base: one banner when the conflict appears, one when it is gone
